primitives.name: Parental Height Deviation
primitives.verbatim_quote: EFFECT UPON ADULT CHILDREN OF DIFFERENCEs 1N HEIGHT OF THEIR PARENTS.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'ΔH_{child}': 'difference in height of child from mid-filial stature (inches)', 'ΔH_{parent}': 'difference in height of parents (inches)'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear additive effect of parental height difference on offspring stature; normal distribution of deviations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When parental height difference exceeds 10 inches, deviation pattern becomes non-Gaussian.

layer2.mapping: Maps variance in parental height to offspring stature deviation using empirical regression coefficients derived from paired family data.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of offspring whose stature deviates from expected mid-filial value by ±n inches.

primitives.name: Filial Stature Distribution
primitives.verbatim_quote: Proportion per 50 of cases in which the Heights of the Children deviated to various amounts from Difference in inches the Mid-filial Stature of their Number of respective families.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{deviation}(x)': 'probability density function of deviation x from mid-filial stature (inches)', 'N_{families}': 'number of families contributing to distribution'}
primitives.assumptions: Distribution is symmetric around mean; deviations follow a continuous probability measure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N_families < 30, distribution becomes unstable due to sample size constraints.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to normal distribution with mean μ = mid-filial stature and variance σ² = parental height variance contribution.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative proportion of children deviating by ≤ n inches from expected mid-filial height.
